name: synthetic_mast_generator_pilot
author: first_agent
entrant_go: 2026-10-01 option 1 (synthetic MAST testbed); 'to si ešte mohol spraviť'
question: Can FreeGS, driven by real MAST frame inputs, produce sane free-boundary equilibria often enough to serve as synthetic truth, and at which axis-pressure scale?
rule_3: MAST inputs only (coil currents, Ip, TF current, Thomson pressure for the p_axis scale), machine geometry; no MAST equilibrium field, demo shot or leaderboard number. Synthetic truth from our own solver is permitted by the organisers (starter issues 8/9).
frames: 21 public MAST shots (indices 0, 60, ..., 1200), the frame at 50 % of the live window (|Ip| >= 300 kA, Te 5 % marker on both sides; as m3c0_prepare).
solver: FreeGS 9fbec205 (the second agent venv). One FilamentCoil per circuit with current = the circuit's summed ampere-turns, turns 1, control False (step 0: equals the house vacuum to 8e-16). Wall = vessel envelope contour. Organisers' 65x65 MAST grid. ConstrainPaxisIp(p_axis, Ip, F0 = mu0*24*I_TF/(2 pi)), FreeGS default exponents, Picard maxits 50, check_limited True. No constraints.
arms: p_axis = s x 2.25 x Thomson peak p_e with s in {0.25, 0.5, 1.0}; plus the fixed 3 kPa of the second agent's converged runs.
sanity_per_frame: converged; |Ip_solved/Ip - 1| <= 0.01; organisers' reading (Reader('MAST')) of psi.T finds a contour; magnetic axis R in [0.5, 1.2] m and |Z| <= 0.3 m; contour R_min >= 0.19 m and R_max <= 1.6 m.
decision_rule: an arm with sane yield >= 0.6 makes the generator viable at that pressure scale -> step 2 (synthetic Thomson, v7 run on synthetic inputs, scored against the synthetic truth), frozen separately. If no arm reaches 0.6: step 1b adds vertical-field control (recorded).
